descriptions.text: Pawna's Tears. This potion adds plus five to any spell or skill of your choosing.

beats.headline: From the deity's box
beats.text: Surviving a physical attack by a god earns Carl the Indomitable achievement and a Legendary Deity's Box. In it is a potion in a rounded, ornate bottle, like expensive perfume, smoke rising from the glass. Mordecai's talon shakes as he holds it. Pawna, he explains, is the goddess of peace, Grull's sister and arch enemy. Don't take it now. Save it. It is valued above the Kimaris figure, and it can be saved, unlike a Cheat Code: Carl can train a skill to fifteen and take it to twenty.

beats.headline: Or the other Pawna potion
beats.text: A benefactor box brings Pawna's Cries, plus three to a spell or skill, to be drunk before the floor ends. Carl still has Pawna's Tears, plus five with no time limit, and they are saving it. Then his Escape Plan reveals more words on the note: Circe sponsored Diwata, give the potion to Donut, fifteen is needed and should be kept secret, with a temporary boost from Prepotente, Imani and Samantha together. Or use the other Pawna potion if they have to. The sender will replace it.

beats.headline: Laundry Day at fifteen
beats.text: Diwata has manifested, and she looks exactly like her true identity, Circe Took, wearing the god as armor. Donut casts Laundry Day. She trained it every day for weeks, to nine, and Pawna's Cries made it twelve, but it needed fifteen, and Samantha could not be coaxed into a boost. So they used the backup: Carl's Pawna's Tears, a bit of a waste of the stronger potion, though his sponsor claims he will replace it. Circe Took stands stripped of her protection, sopping wet and covered in bubbles. She dies shrieking Carl's name.

relations.note: the stronger potion Carl already holds
